text:
mika: Tiny sync: product confirmed v1 sunset. We need a short PR to add a legacy banner, update JS/py streaming snippets, and add one-line embed-dim troubleshooting. Can owners?

trent: I'll update JS snippets and add a before/after streaming example. Will include the shim example: `new RedwoodClient({ featureFlags: ['docs.v1_compat_shim'] })`.

ash: I'll take Python and the embed-dim triage note. Plan to show a fallback pattern that retries with a compat model id.

docs-bot: Reminder: label PRs `docs/compat` and `preview/ready` to trigger preview. Editorial freeze 48h before deprecation email.

trent: Draft streaming diff for the thread: `// v1: client.stream({ model_id, onData: cb })` -> `// v2: client.stream({ model, onEvent: ({ event, chunk }) => {} })`. Adding small migration note.

ash: Python embed fallback snippet for docs: `vec = embeds.create(model='rwd-embed-v2', input=text); if len(vec) != expected_dim: vec = embeds.create(model='rwd-embed-compat', input=text)`

qa-bot: Quick checklist: open PRs, preview build green, smoke snippet tests pass, legacy pages show banner. Mark any snippet failures `impact/high`.

mika: Timeline: PRs up by EOD, review Thursday, merge Friday morning. Ping here if blocked.

trent: PR opened, tag `preview/ready`.

(brief)

qa-bot: Preview run green. Streaming TS snippet needed a tiny tweak; trent pushed fix. All smoke tests passing.

mika: Great, merging after final approvals. I'll post the one-pager link to support templates. Thanks!
